tasks.short: Read drawings to establish structural steel requirements

steps.what: Locate the issued specifications and blueprint sheets
Read specifications and blueprints to determine material locations, quantities and sizes

tasks.design: Configure the {DOCS} issued-drawing register for direct sheet retrieval by drawing number and revision. The worker still interprets dimensions, member marks and specification conflicts; a search hit is not a material requirement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Workers can spend time locating sheets in large issued drawing sets.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed document search can shorten location without interpreting the structure.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling details, revisions and real site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The worker recognises when a drawing detail does not match the intended installation.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less sheet hunting; no new engineering decision rights.

reach.learn: Identify sheet, revision, member mark and conflicting dimensions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed document search can locate exact sheet references, but cannot establish that a structural interpretation is safe.

assumptions: Boundary is locating and reading issued drawings; engineering design, material ordering and erection are outside this task.

Document controller already produces drawing number, revision, issue status, issue date and file link in the issued register. That existing upstream duty is unchanged and earns no saving; s1's 14 retained hours include entering search terms and checking revision. Missing or unreliable metadata means manual sheet location, not automatic inference.
Test native document search first; no saving from existing search runtime or from interpreting dimensions is claimed.
Two focal upkeep hours cover failed searches and reporting incorrect links; any new controller indexing work requires a separate cost estimate before rollout.
research_questions: Does exact-sheet search reduce location time while workers still check the correct revision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94, gross=6 and net=4 after two upkeep hours. Range assumes a modest actual sheet-location burden; interpreting all material requirements remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Lift and position structural steel members

steps.what: Lift structural steel or signal equipment operators to position members

tasks.design: Keep lifting and live signalling with competent site personnel. A lift plan in {DOCS} is a reference for the crew, not an automatic instruction to move a load.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires physical equipment control and awareness of people and loads.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change removes the worker's physical or signalling duties.
tasks.still_hard: Visibility, changing conditions and coordination with the operator.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can stop movement when conditions differ from the plan.
tasks.altitude: The worker retains the same lifting and signalling responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structural steel lifting and live signalling depend on physical equipment, site awareness and competent people.

assumptions: Boundary is this worker's lifting or signalling contribution; other operators' concurrent work is outside the denominator and unchanged.

The existing lift-planning authority produces the authorised lift plan before this task; the worker checks readiness and conditions within s1. No structured safe-to-lift flag is assumed and any uncertainty stops movement for manual resolution.
Review existing tools before introducing software; current equipment runtime is not a new labour saving.
Zero upkeep because this proposal makes no process or technology change.
unknowns: Which lifting role the worker holds
research_questions: Where does a site observation differ from the preplanned lifting conditions?

already_counted.description: Physical control, observation and live coordination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. The physical task and all operator coordination retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use more reliable drawing retrieval while retaining responsibility for interpretation and site execution.
reach: Raise traceable drawing queries for the construction supervisor
role.ambitious_version: A steelworker who can find the right drawing promptly and recognise when erection must stop for clarification.
